title: script.getscriptsbyhosts
description: Retrieve all available scripts on the given host, or a specific script if a script ID is provided. When manualinput is provided, it substitutes the {MANUALINPUT} macro with the specified value.

hostid.description: ID of host to return scripts for. Must be unique. Required.

manualinput.description: Value of the user-provided {MANUALINPUT} macro value.
